constraints.description: Students must complete a fixed set of required core courses plus one option from each of several paired alternative sequences in biology, chemistry, math, and physics.
constraints.note: Paired courses within each alternative sequence are grouped as single options because they must be taken together.

constraints.source_text: Eight units of upper-division, non-core course work available for major credit in biological sciences or chemistry are required.
constraints.description: Students must take eight units of upper-division, non-core coursework available for major credit in biological sciences or chemistry.

details.pool_rule: upper-division, non-core coursework available for major credit in biological sciences or chemistry

constraints.source_text: Students enrolled in BISC 490 are limited to 4 units
constraints.description: Units of BISC 490 counted toward the elective requirement are capped at 4.

constraints.source_text: students enrolled in CHEM 490 may complete up to 8 units
constraints.description: Units of CHEM 490 counted toward the elective requirement are capped at 8.

constraints.source_text: No more than two seminars (BISC 460 to BISC 462 ), totaling 4 units, may be applied to the upper-division elective requirement.
constraints.description: No more than two seminars from BISC 460 to BISC 462, totaling 4 units, may count toward the upper-division elective requirement.

unclassified.source_text: The general education, writing, foreign language and diversity requirements for a degree in the USC Dornsife College of Letters, Arts and Sciences are applicable.
unclassified.why: References college-wide general education requirements without specifying any course list or bound relevant to this program; not a program-specific constraint.
